name: project_structure_guard
description: Port of agent-toolbox project-structure-guardian scan-all.sh decision layer. The probe runs the six filesystem/git checks (root_directory / log_files / documentation / folder_structure / configuration_files / gitignore) and folds them into failures/warnings counts plus a health score (100 - failures*10 - warnings*3). This spec reproduces the shell's exit-code ladder: any failure -> FAIL (exit 1), else any warning -> WARN (exit 2), else OK (exit 0). The health score rides along as action_answer so callers can render the report band. failure_count fails closed (score_miss 1) when the probe omits the field.

failure_count.instructions: Number of FAIL-level structure findings (missing required files, tracked binaries, root/src/docs log files, tracked .env, missing/empty .gitignore).

warning_count.instructions: Number of WARN-level structure findings (untracked binaries, large files, missing logs/docs dirs, scattered root docs, YAML config, temp dirs not ignored, missing .gitignore patterns).

health_score.instructions: Health score 0-100 computed by the probe as 100 - failures*10 - warnings*3, clamped to [0,100]. Passed through as the action payload value.
